ad_library.summary: Orizen Solar Innovations is running a live Telugu Meta ad (Library ID 3529873930505195, started 18 September 2026, multiple versions) with a Dussehra & Deepavali offer - Rs.78,000 subsidy, 3KW with Rs.10,000 off, 5KW with Rs.20,000 off - and every click goes to WhatsApp, so the website never sees the paid traffic. The site is the only one of the three audited sites with the Meta Pixel installed (ID 1655381782019850) and it is the only one with a Google Ads presence (1 ad via the Transparency Center) - but the pixel fires PageView only, never a Lead event, and there is no GA4 or GTM behind it. SEO is weak where it is easiest to fix: no Open Graph tags, no structured data, no sitemap, two competing H1 tags, and a hero carousel whose H1s are commented out of the code. Template leftovers are still live on the page - 'At Your Solar Partner' in the PM Surya Ghar blurb, a mailto:example@example.com email icon and a 'Features of Origin Solar Panels' heading for a company called Orizen.
